decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that fully captures the required PDF handoff to the client for Heyzine upload.
Selecting client-owned white-label Heyzine hosting and client upload responsibility does not change the established launch deadline or required live state.
The hosting and branding decision does not alter article-ending whitespace rules; the same message's separate instruction to use images without extra text is already represented.
The Heyzine hosting, white-label branding, and upload arrangement does not change advertisement rendering quality.
Provider white-label branding concerns the hosting platform and does not modify the magazine's WBEdition visual-style requirements.
The hosting-platform decision does not change the requirement to enhance publication image assets when needed.
Heyzine account ownership, white-label status, and upload responsibility do not affect the selected article typography.
The hosting and branding decision does not add, remove, or otherwise change required magazine content.
The selected hosting arrangement does not change the issue's pagination, flat-plan ordering, or article-placement rules.
The Heyzine hosting and upload decision does not alter table-of-contents completion or page-number accuracy requirements.
The hosting-platform and branding change does not affect author names, photographs, sizing, shape, coverage, or source.
